title: Auto-select shape-specific description template in BulkProductUpload

requirements.summary: Implement automatic shape-based description template selection in BulkProductUpload component, matching product shape values (Turtle, Dolphin, Frog, Whale) to corresponding named templates, falling back to Default template for other shapes, while preserving user-edited descriptions
acceptanceCriteria: When a product's shape field is set to 'Dolphin', the description field is automatically populated with the Dolphin template content.
When a product's shape field is set to 'Turtle', the description field is automatically populated with the Turtle template content.
When a product's shape field is set to 'Frog', the description field is automatically populated with the Frog template content.
When a product's shape field is set to 'Whale', the description field is automatically populated with the Whale template content.
When a product's shape field is set to any value other than Turtle, Dolphin, Frog, or Whale (including blank/empty), the description field falls back to the Default template content.
The auto-selection triggers each time the shape field value changes for a product.
If the user has manually edited the description field for a product, changing the shape does not overwrite their manual edits.
The template dropdown selector continues to function independently, allowing the user to manually override the auto-selected template.

file_operations.description: Add shape-based automatic template selection logic. Track whether each product's description has been manually edited using a new state field (e.g., manuallyEditedDescriptions: Set<number>). When a product's shape field changes, check if the description was manually edited; if not, find the matching template by name (Turtle, Dolphin, Frog, Whale, or Default as fallback) and auto-populate the description field with that template's content. Ensure the existing template dropdown remains functional for manual overrides. Clear the manuallyEdited flag when the user explicitly selects a template from the dropdown. Update the handleFieldChange function to mark descriptions as manually edited when the user types in the description textarea. Implement a useEffect or inline handler to trigger auto-selection whenever the shape value changes for any product row.
